credits.actor: Gordon Liu I Wang Yu I Lo Lieh I Yu

credits.actor: Anthony Chan I Kara Hui I Chao Wen

programme.title: The Five Venoms / 五毒
programme.desc: The dying master of the powerful Poison Clan dispatches his last pupil, Yang Tieh, on a crucial mission to atone for the evil deeds of his clan disciples.

credits.actor: Kuo Chue I Sun Chien I Chiang Sheng

programme.title: Rose, Be My Love / 玫瑰我爱你
programme.desc: A love rectangle lies at the heart of this romantic drama with an eve of World War II setting. Starring Kwan Shan, Li Ting.

credits.actor: Pat Ting Hung I Li Ting I Kwan Shan

programme.title: Rape of the Sword / 盗剑
programme.desc: When a swordswoman falters in her attempt to reclaim her murdered husband's 'Green Sword', the world's sharpest blade, her protg continues her quest.

credits.actor: Li Li Hua I Li Ching I Chiao Chuang

programme.title: The Mermaid / 鱼美人

credits.actor: Ivy Ling Po I Li Ching I Ching Miao

programme.title: The 14 Amazons / 十四女英豪
programme.desc: This award-winning film starts when Yang Tsung-pao is killed while fighting invaders from West Hsia - and the Yang clan forms their own army in retaliation.

credits.actor: Ivy Ling Po I Lily Ho I Yueh Hua I

programme.title: King Drummer / 青春鼓王
programme.desc: In Shaw Brothers' showcase for the talented Ling Yun, a young drummer hungry for fame sacrifices everything including love, for his art. Will the prize prove worth the cost?

credits.actor: Lily Ho I Ling Yun I Yang Fang I Ch

programme.desc: This is the first of four related Shaw Brothers film adaptations of the legendary Journey To The West.

credits.actor: Yueh Hua I Peng Peng I Tien Shun I

programme.title: Black Magic 2 / 勾魂降头
programme.desc: In this mind-blowing sequel to the Shaw Brothers' horror hit, zombies run amok, driving doctors to seek a natural cause while the actual one may be supernatural.

credits.actor: Ti Lung I Tanny Tien Ni I Lily Li I

programme.title: Tales of a Eunuch / 鹿鼎记

credits.actor: Wang Yu I Ku Feng I Linda Chu I Lia

credits.actor: Lin Dai I Chao Lei I Yang Chi Ching

programme.title: The Web of Death / 五毒天罗

credits.actor: Yueh Hua I Lo Lieh I Ching Li

credits.actor: Cheng Pei Pei I Yueh Hua I Huang Ts

programme.title: The Blue and the Black Part 2 / 蓝与黑续集
programme.desc: This sequel captures how singer Tang Qi searches through battle-scarred China for her soldier lover, Xing Ya. However, are they fated to be apart?

credits.actor: Lin Dai I Kwan Shan I Pat Ting Hung

programme.title: Vengeance / 报仇
programme.desc: In this award-winning Chang Cheh film, David Chiang plays a psychotic who stops at nothing to avenge his elder brother's death.

credits.actor: David Chiang I Wang Ping I Ti Lung

programme.title: The Yellow Muffler / 玉女嬉春
programme.desc: This Inoue Umetsugu musical depicts the struggle of two singing sisters, Ching Ping and Pai Hung.

credits.actor: Betty Ting Pei I Tsung Hua I Paul C

programme.title: A Taste of Cold Steel / 武林风云

credits.actor: Chang I I Chen Hung Lieh I Shu Pei

programme.title: Big Times for the Crazy Bumpkins / 阿牛发达记

credits.actor: Wang Sha I Yeh Feng I Ai Ti

programme.desc: A superhero (Danny Lee) must save the earth from legions of demons and monsters led by a blonde-haired Demon Princess.

credits.actor: Danny Lee I Terry Liu I Wang Hsieh

credits.actor: Anthony Chan I Meg Lam Kin Ming I A

credits.actor: Kuo Chue I Lo Meng I Chiang Sheng I

programme.title: Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers? / 喷火美人鱼
programme.desc: A beauty is accused of slaying her boyfriends. After fleeing to Lantau Island, she seduces another man there.

credits.actor: Jenny Hu I Chin Han I Irene Chen I

programme.title: What Price Honesty / 目无王法
programme.desc: Pai Piao, Danny Lee and 'Venom's' Sun Chien play idealistic police graduates who run afoul of powerful, corrupt individuals in this farsighted film.

credits.actor: Pai Piao I Danny Lee I Sun Chien I

programme.title: What Price Honesty / 目无王法
programme.desc: Pai Piao, Danny Lee and 'Venom's' Sun Chien play idealistic police graduates who run afoul of powerful, corrupt individuals in this farsighted film.

credits.actor: Pai Piao I Danny Lee I Sun Chien I

programme.title: Batie Girl / 巴铁女孩
programme.desc: Lu You, a famous young Chinese female footballer, is struck by injury and that puts an end to her sports career. She is down into the dumps and comes to the droughty, poor and backward village in north Pakistan to escape from it, where she accidentally helps the little girls realize their football dreams and alters the course of the girls' miserable life - getting married at the age of 13. For Lu You, the kindness and innocence of the Pakistani girls gradually opens up her heart that's been long shut to the outside and revives her confidence to step up to life. In the end, new sources of water in the village are gotten through by the Chinese enterprises which offer assistance to the construction of Pakistan due to the effort of this Chinese girl, thus radically changing the predicament of poverty and backwardness here.
